tools.name: cortex_ping
tools.description: Health check rapido del MCP server. Devuelve JSON con {status, version, uptime_seconds, indices_loaded, models_loaded, last_error_seen}. Latencia objetivo <50ms. Pensado para que los agentes verifiquen disponibilidad ANTES de gastar tiempo y contexto en operaciones costosas. Si status != 'ok', abortar la operacion con error claro al usuario; NO degradar features, NO hacer fallback manual.

tools.name: cortex_search_vector
tools.description: Búsqueda semántica profunda en el vault (Requiere carga de modelo ONNX). Úsala para análisis inicial y contexto histórico complejo.

tools.name: cortex_search
tools.description: Búsqueda rápida de palabras clave (Bypass IA - Instantánea). Úsala para encontrar archivos, funciones o términos específicos sin carga de modelos. Acepta filtros estructurales opcionales (doc_type, scope, status, tags, max_age_days, strict): si alguno es informado, el resultado se construye con ContextEnricher en lugar del RRF crudo (mismo backend que `cortex docs search`).

tag.description: Items deben contener TODOS los tags.

tag_any.description: Items deben contener al menos uno de estos tags.

max_age_days.description: Descartar items más antiguos que N días.

strict.description: Descartar items sin doc_type cuando doc_type filtra.

tools.name: cortex_context
tools.description: Recuperar contexto enriquecido del proyecto y grafos de dependencia.

changed_files.description: Archivos modificados para enriquecer el contexto.

keywords.description: Palabras clave opcionales para complementar la consulta.

pr_title.description: Titulo opcional del PR o tarea actual.

task_type.description: Detected task type (question-only | docs-only | fast-code | deep-code | security | ambiguous | noop). When supplied, the server sizes the retrieval envelope via cortex.context_enricher.budget_resolver. Unknown values fall back to fast-code defaults.

complexity.description: Reserved for Phase 09 complexity tuning. Currently accepted but unused.

tools.name: cortex_sync_ticket
tools.description: Paso obligatorio de cortex-sync. Inyecta el pedido actual del usuario junto con contexto historico similar recuperado por ONNX/hybrid retrieval para preparar una spec.

user_request.description: Pedido textual actual del usuario en la terminal.

changed_files.description: Archivos ya identificados para el ticket actual. Acepta array de strings o un string CSV ("a.py,b.py").

keywords.description: Palabras clave opcionales para reforzar la recuperacion. Acepta array de strings o un string CSV ("fase,roadmap").

title_hint.description: Titulo corto opcional para orientar la spec.

tools.name: cortex_create_spec
tools.description: Persistir una especificacion técnica (Spec) en el vault.

verification_hooks.description: Executable commands that prove the work is done (Pluggable Middle, Phase 01). Optional for legacy compatibility; new specs should declare at least one.

proposal_mode.description: Phase 09.A: gate on the cortex-sync proposal step. 'required' rejects the call unless proposal_confirmed is True.

proposal_confirmed.description: Phase 09.A: signal that the cortex-sync proposal has been acknowledged by the user.

tools.name: cortex_emit_proposal
tools.description: Phase 09.A+: emit a structured proposal as a Markdown card visible to the user. After calling this tool, the agent MUST end its turn — do NOT chain cortex_create_spec in the same response. The server enforces a minimum gap between emit_proposal and a follow-up create_spec with proposal_confirmed=true, rejecting fake same-turn confirmations.

summary.description: Executive summary in 2-3 lines describing what is being proposed.

id.description: Short token (A, B, C, ...) the user can reference.

rejected_reason.description: Empty for the recommended alternative; non-empty explanation for the rest.

recommendation_id.description: Id of the alternative the agent recommends. Must match an entry in 'alternatives'.

risks.description: Optional list of risks/assumptions the user is implicitly accepting.

tools.name: cortex_save_session
tools.description: Documentar una sesion de trabajo y sus cambios en el vault.

handoff.description: Marca la sesion como handoff cross-session (Tripartita Refinada).

blockers.description: Bloqueos abiertos que el siguiente agente debe resolver.

verified_state.description: Hechos verificados contra el diff o tests reales.

unverified_claims.description: Afirmaciones sin verificar que el siguiente agente debe re-chequear.

suggested_skills.description: Skills/subagents recomendados para retomar el trabajo.

tools.name: cortex_validate_handoff
tools.description: Validate a structured agent handoff (YAML). Use this between subagents to enforce the cortex.handoff.AgentHandoff schema. Returns OK with normalized fields or an error message detailing the schema violations.

expected_agent.description: (Optional) Assert the handoff's agent field matches this value.

tools.name: cortex_verify_session_claims
tools.description: Verify session claims against the actual git diff. Returns a structured breakdown of verified / asserted / contradicted claims that the documenter can use to fill the confidence field.

files_to_check.description: Optional file allowlist to scope verification.

tools.name: cortex_import_hu
tools.description: Importar una historia o work item externo en modo read-only.

external_id.description: Clave del item externo, por ejemplo PROJ-123.

tools.name: cortex_get_hu
tools.description: Obtener la nota local ya importada de una HU o work item.

item_id.description: ID local o externo, por ejemplo PROJ-123.

tools.name: cortex_sync_vault
tools.description: Sincronizar el vault y re-indexar documentos semanticamente.

tools.name: cortex_autopilot_start
tools.description: Start a new Autopilot session.

tools.name: cortex_autopilot_preflight
tools.description: Run Autopilot preflight detection for a session.

tools.name: cortex_autopilot_checkpoint
tools.description: Record an Autopilot checkpoint.

tools.name: cortex_autopilot_finish
tools.description: Finish an Autopilot session and optionally persist a draft.

tools.name: cortex_autopilot_status
tools.description: Get the current Autopilot status.

tools.name: cortex_session_open
tools.description: Open a new Session anchored on a spec. Normally invoked automatically by cortex_create_spec; exposed here for testing and for callers that manage Sessions manually. Returns JSON with session_id, opened_at, start_commit, start_branch.

spec_path.description: Path to the persisted spec file.

tools.name: cortex_session_checkpoint
tools.description: Append a checkpoint to an OPEN Session. Used by the middle (SDDwork, code-explorer, code-implementer) and by IDE hooks to enrich the Session with verified/unverified claims, artifacts touched and a short context note.

tools.name: cortex_session_close
tools.description: Close an OPEN Session into a terminal status. Captures HEAD as end_commit and infers the mode (managed / observed / byo) from the existing checkpoints. Returns JSON with session_id, closed_at, end_commit, mode_inferred.

tools.name: cortex_session_status
tools.description: Return the full SessionRecord for a session_id (or the active session if session_id is omitted).

tools.name: cortex_finish_session
tools.description: Close a Session: reconstruct context from the spec + diff + checkpoints, run the verification hooks declared in the spec, persist the session note (and any ADR candidates), and mark the underlying Session as CLOSED / HANDOFF / ABANDONED. Returns JSON with session_note_path, adrs_created, final_status, summary_text.

session_id.description: Session id to finish (default: active session).

intent.description: Override the auto-suggested status. 'auto' uses the reconstructor's verdict; 'handoff' / 'abandon' force the closure.

tools.name: cortex_documenter_briefing
tools.description:
Phase 09.A+ / May 2026 — READ-ONLY reconstruction of a Session for the /cortex-documenter skill. Runs the 8-step Reconstructor (sin persistir nada ni cerrar la sesion). Returns ReconstructionOutput JSON: spec, diff_text, diff_entries, files_verified_by_git, files_declared_only, files_touched (union), in_scope / out_of_scope / unimplemented, verification_results, contradictions, suggested_status, suggested_adrs, raw_checkpoints, end_commit, gitless.

By default ``run_hooks=false`` — verification hooks (``npm ci && build``, integration tests, etc.) NO se ejecutan dentro del briefing porque pueden tardar minutos y reventar el timeout del MCP. SDDwork tipicamente ya los corrio antes de cerrar; si necesitas verificarlos otra vez, pasá ``run_hooks=true`` explicitamente y considera subir el timeout client-side.

run_hooks.description: If true, execute the spec's verification_hooks during the reconstruction. Default false to keep the briefing fast and avoid MCP timeouts on heavy hooks (npm build, tests, etc.).

tools.name: cortex_close_session
tools.description: Phase 09.A+ / May 2026 — close an OPEN Session without re-running the reconstructor. Intended as the FINAL step of the /cortex-documenter skill after it has called cortex_documenter_briefing and persisted the session note + ADRs (via the write_*_note_canonical tools). Records final status, an optional note_path, and any ADR paths the skill created. Returns JSON with the closed SessionRecord summary.

status.description: Terminal status the documenter decided. Use 'handoff' when the work is incomplete or verification hooks failed; 'abandoned' when the work was discarded; 'closed' otherwise.

session_note_path.description: Optional absolute path to the persisted session note (returned by write_session_note_canonical).

adrs_created.description: Paths of ADR notes the skill created during this close (if any).

tools.name: cortex_session_list
tools.description: List Sessions, optionally filtered by status. Returns a JSON array of summarized SessionRecord objects (without full checkpoint arrays — use cortex_session_status for that).

tools.name: cortex_self_review_note
tools.description: Phase 09.A+ / May 2026 — pure inspection of a draft note body written by the /cortex-documenter skill. Scans for placeholder tokens (TBD, TODO, FIXME, ???, ...), hollow success claims ("tests pass" without a corresponding verification hook result), and other low-signal smells. Returns JSON {warnings: [str], passed: bool}. INFORMATIONAL only — never blocks persistence. The skill decides whether to revise and re-call, or accept the warnings and proceed.

body.description: The Markdown body the skill drafted. Scanned case-insensitively.

verification_hooks_passed.description: Whether at least one verification hook in the spec actually passed. Drives the hollow-claim detector — claiming "tests pass" is hollow if no hook reported success.

tools.name: cortex_write_doc
tools.description:
Phase 09.A+ / May 2026 — generic canonical writer dispatched by ``doc_type``. Used by the ``/cortex-documenter`` skill to persist any of the 11 supported doc types under their canonical vault folder. The ``payload`` shape varies per doc_type; minimum required fields per type:

• ``session``     → title, spec_summary, session_id
• ``handoff``     → title, parent_session_id
• ``adr``         → title, context, decision
• ``decision``    → title, context, decision
• ``incident``    → title, short_description, severity
• ``postmortem``  → title, incident_path, incident_number, root_cause
• ``runbook``     → title, runbook_kind, procedure
• ``architecture``→ title, summary
• ``changelog``   → title, version
• ``glossary``    → title, term, definition
• ``hu``          → title, external_id, source

Every payload accepts the common fields ``tags`` (list[str]), ``links`` (list[str]), ``status`` (str). Returns JSON {path, doc_type}.

NOTE: ``spec`` and ``design`` doc types are NOT exposed here — use ``cortex_create_spec`` and ``write_design_note_canonical`` respectively.

payload.description: Fields for the chosen doc_type. See the description above for the minimum required fields per type.

tools.name: write_design_note_canonical
tools.description: Persist a design document under vault/designs/ (Pluggable Middle Phase 09.B). Used by cortex-code-designer between explorer and implementer in Deep Track. Returns the absolute path of the persisted note.

tools.name: cortex_session_task_list
tools.description: List the granular tasks attached to a Session (Pluggable Middle Phase 09.C). Optionally filter by status. Returns a JSON array of Task objects in declaration order.

tools.name: cortex_session_task_update
tools.description: Mutate one task's status (Pluggable Middle Phase 09.C). If the task doesn't exist yet, it is created on the fly when ``description`` is supplied — that is how SDDwork emits a task decomposition in one pass. Setting ``status='done'`` stamps ``completed_at`` automatically. Returns JSON with task_id and new status.

description.description: Required when the task does not exist yet (auto-creates a new task with the given description + initial status).

tools.name: cortex_review_checkpoint
tools.description: Run the two-stage quality review on a checkpoint of an OPEN Session. Stage 1 verifies spec compliance (artifacts in scope; checkpoint reports progress); stage 2 verifies quality (no placeholder tokens in note; non-trivial test/build claims). Returns JSON with accepted, stage_1_passed, stage_2_passed, reason, action (one of accept|redelegate|warn).

checkpoint_index.description: Index into session.checkpoints. Negative indexing is supported (default: -1, most recent).
